name: Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026
short_description: A Garmin-branded half-marathon event with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances held October 25, 2026 in Pasay, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026 is a half-marathon event taking place on October 25, 2026 at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, Philippines. Organized by HyveSports under the Garmin brand, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining any of these distances.

core_facts.venue: SM Mall of Asia Complex, Pasay

pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) to suit different runner levels
Held at the accessible and well-known SM Mall of Asia Complex
Registration is currently open, giving participants time to prepare

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this race?
faqs.answer: The Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026 offers three distance options for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This gives runners of varying experience levels and fitness goals the flexibility to select a distance suited to their own capabilities.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: This race is organized by HyveSports, and it is branded under Garmin as part of the Garmin Run Marathon Series. The event is being held in the Philippines, specifically at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, on October 25, 2026.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Garmin Run Marathon Series – Philippines 2026 is currently open. Interested participants can sign up for any of the three available distances: the 21.1km half-marathon, the 10km race, or the 5km race, ahead of the October 25, 2026 event date.

faqs.question: Where and when will this race take place?
faqs.answer: The race will take place on October 25, 2026 at the SM Mall of Asia Complex, located in Pasay, in the Philippines. This venue serves as the host location for all three distance categories offered as part of this Garmin-branded running event.
